text: A delay reservoir works best near the 'edge of stability', with feedback gain η just below the ___ threshold — analogous to a spectral radius just below 1 in a digital ESN.
explanation: The framework describes optimal operation with the loop gain just below the onset of self-oscillation: dissipative enough for fading memory, yet sensitive enough to separate inputs. This maps onto the digital ESN's ρ just below 1 — the same memory-vs-separation trade-off at the critical point.
